editorial:
Imagine falling head over heels for someone only to find out their time is running out. That is exactly what happens to Daryn, a teen who meets the spirited Isabelle. She is dealing with a scary illness, but she does not want her final days to be spent in a hospital bed. Instead, she challenges Daryn to give her a whole lifetime of experiences in just one year. You will feel the chemistry between the two leads right away, and the movie does a great job of making you root for them even though you know a sad ending is coming. It is a real tear-jerker that focuses on making every single second count.

The acting is sweet and feels natural, though some of the plot points feel a bit rushed. You might find some parts too cheesy, but that is kind of the point with these kinds of romance movies. If you are in the mood for a good cry, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: After a year of amazing adventures, Isabelle eventually passes away, leaving Daryn heartbroken. However, she left behind a series of letters and videos for him to find. These messages guide him through his grief and encourage him to keep living his life to the fullest. The movie ends with Daryn finding peace and realizing that their short time together taught him more about love and life than most people learn in eighty years.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves a good cry and romantic stories about young love.
